nameOrigin: of or relating to the sea

pokedexEntries.go: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

pokedexEntries.si: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

pokedexEntries.cr: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it’s in the water.

pokedexEntries.ru: AZUMARILL’s long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this POKéMON can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.

pokedexEntries.sa: AZUMARILL can make balloons out of air. It makes these air balloons if it spots a drowning POKéMON. The air balloons enable the POKéMON in trouble to breathe.

pokedexEntries.fr: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

pokedexEntries.lg: By keeping still and listening intently, it can even tell what is in wild, fast-moving rivers.

pokedexEntries.em: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

pokedexEntries.di: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

pokedexEntries.pt: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
